questions.stem_text:
Which statement below is the least likely to follow logically from Dworkin's notion of law
as integrity?

options.A: It is likely to generate more individual rights and greater liberty.
options.B: It renders a community more genuine.
options.C: It opens the door to authoritarianism.
options.D: It improves the moral justification for the exercise of political power.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - It opens the door to authoritarianism.

questions.stem_text:
The U.S. Congress is empowered by the Commerce Clause and other provisions of the U.S.
Constitution to enact ________ to regulate foreign and interstate commerce.
What is the purpose of sovereign immunity?

options.A: The purpose of immunity is to protect foreign Heads of State from embarrassment
options.B: Immunity protects a State from being invaded by another
options.C: Immunity shields States from being sued in the courts of other States
options.D: The purpose of immunity is to offer impunity in respect of all crimes

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Immunity shields States from being sued in the courts of other States

questions.stem_text: Why does Dworkin support liberal egalitarianism?

options.A: Because it attempts to give effect to personal choice over individual luck.
options.B: Because liberty is more important than equality.
options.C: Because a market economy is just.
options.D: Because the state is the best arbiter of equality between individuals.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Because it attempts to give effect to personal choice over individual luck.

questions.stem_text: Is recognition of governments prevalent in contemporary international practice?

options.A: Recognition of governments is very prevalent in contemporary practice
options.B: Recognition of governments has largely been replaced by functional Recognition
options.C: Government recognition is common in respect of rebel entities
options.D: Only democratic governments are recognised in contemporary practice

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - Recognition of governments has largely been replaced by functional Recognition
